reservationSettings.title: Reservation settings
reservationSettings.subtitle: How reservations are confirmed, how tables are assigned, how long a reservation lasts and which rules apply to bookings. The settings apply to new reservations.

instant.label: Instant confirmation
instant.description: The reservation is confirmed as soon as the guest books.

request.label: Request
request.description: The guest sends a request; the restaurant has to approve it before it is confirmed.

guestChooses.label: Guest chooses a table
guestChooses.description: The guest picks a free table on the floor plan when booking.

systemAssigns.label: System assigns a table
systemAssigns.description: The guest only chooses date, time and party size; the system picks a suitable free table.

duration.title: Duration
duration.defaultDescription: Applies when no rule matches the party size.
duration.rulesDescription: Optional. Ranges must not overlap; for party sizes between the rules the default duration applies.
duration.noRules: No rules yet: every reservation lasts the default duration.
duration.previewResult_one: For a party of {{guests}}, a reservation lasts {{count}} minute.
duration.previewResult_other: For a party of {{guests}}, a reservation lasts {{count}} minutes.

rules.title: Booking rules
rules.description: Lead time, booking horizon and the largest party apply to online bookings only; staff can enter any reservation. The buffer applies to all reservations.
rules.leadTimeDescription: Guests can book online up to this many minutes before the start, e.g. with 60 the earliest time at 18:10 is 19:15. 0: up to the start.
rules.bookingHorizonDescription: How many days ahead guests can book online.
rules.bufferDescription: After every reservation the table stays free for this time, e.g. to clear and lay it. 0 to 60 minutes in steps of 5.
rules.maxOnlinePartySizeDescription: Larger parties are asked to call. Empty: the largest table that can be booked online.
